endorsements.name: Jimi Fiekert
endorsements.label: The Anatomy of Drug Testing
endorsements.description: This talk will cover most of the basics and some of the advanced principles/procedures to how drug screening works. Areas of the subject that will be covered will be the legality of drugs, the legality of drug testing, methods of drug testing, sample types, and reliability.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 18
